scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:start && npm run test:e2e:run; npm run test:e2e:stop
scripts.test:e2e:mock: npm run test:e2e:mock:start && npm run test:e2e:mock:run; npm run test:e2e:mock:stop
scripts.test:e2e:mock:start: npm run test:e2e:start && npx wait-on http://localhost:8089 --timeout 300000 && GW_PORT=3001 REAL_APP=http://localhost:8089 MOCK_SIO=http://localhost:3101 node ws-gateway.cjs > gateway.log 2>&1 & echo $! > gateway.pid && npm run mocks > httpmock.log 2>&1 & echo $! > httpmock.pid && npx wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 tcp:127.0.0.1:3102 --timeout 120000
scripts.test:e2e:mock:stop: kill $(cat gateway.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; kill $(cat httpmock.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; rm -f gateway.pid httpmock.pid; npm run test:e2e:stop
scripts.test:e2e:gfarm: npx dotenv -e cypress/e2e/gfarm/gfarm-e2e.env -- npx cypress run --browser chrome --spec 'cypress/e2e/gfarm/**/*.cy.js'
scripts.test:e2e:gfarm:open: npx dotenv -e cypress/e2e/gfarm/gfarm-e2e.env -- npx cypress open --spec 'cypress/e2e/gfarm/**/*.cy.js'
